english.note: Two-year scores; no MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. DET only when other exams unavailable; DET-only admits take TOEP. English-only US degree or foreign degree with sole English instruction recorded in WHED may exempt; other documentation not accepted. Programs/TA employment may set higher standards.

applicationFee.note: US applicants$135. Central waiver limited to listed graduate-preparation programs, not general financial need. Identify program/coordinator in application; participation verified. International applicants should confirm category eligibility.

requirements.note: Bachelor equivalent, GPA 3. Prior coursework in biochemistry, chemistry, mathematics/statistics, nutrition and physiology; limited deficiencies may be remedied. A major professor must agree to mentor before admission.
